messages:
olivia: Quick question — design spike idea: show a compact cost/latency summary in quicksearch results so engineers can surface 'expensive' routes during discovery. can we do this without killing list perf?
kevin: Doing per-route telemetry fetch for every list item sounds rough. how many routes do we expect to render in quicksearch? 20-50? that multiplies reads.
marta: We could surface only cached, precomputed compact telemetry (1m resolution) with a freshness badge. fallback to 'est.' if not cached. cache key per route_id.
ryan: UX concern — quicksearch is for discovery. adding telemetry might make the list noisy. maybe keep a tiny badge: ⚠️ or a small token-cost label, not full numbers. mobile considerations too.
olivia: Exactly — tiny badge + tooltip. clicking expands a detail panel that fetches a richer telemetry payload. default list stays lightweight.
sanjay: Quota/ops side: each expand -> telemetry read. Need limits: per-request telemetry lookups cap, RBAC, and a quota accounting note so users don't get surprised. searches can be automated -> storms.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature/quicksearch-telemetry -> staging tests started (run id: b7c4).
marta: Implementation proposal: maintain a compact telemetry row for each route updated every minute in Redis. Key: `telemetry:compact:{route_id}` containing p50, p95, tokens_per_call_est. TTL 90s. list reads pull that key.
kevin: API contract note: adding telemetry to search response increases payload. add `?includeTelemetry=true` opt-in param. default false. also server-side feature-flag for rollout.
olivia: Rollout idea: start with 5% orgs, show telemetry only for users with the new 'telemetry-preview' flag. UX copy will clarify "sampled telemetry, may be delayed".
ryan: Saved queries question: should we persist telemetry snapshot at save time? I lean no; snapshots get stale. but we should allow attaching an optional snapshot_id for reproducibility.
sanjay: +1 for optional snapshot_id. Implement as metadata on saved query: `telemetry_snapshot: 2026-03-12T10:00Z` if user requests. Otherwise saved query references live telemetry (if enabled) or none.
marta: Sketch of result object to keep things concrete:
```json
{
  "route_id": "r_123",
  "name": "translate-en->es",
  "compact_telemetry": {
    "p50_ms": 36,
    "tokens_per_call": 124,
    "freshness_s": 42
  }
}
```
kevin: That's good. But let's keep `compact_telemetry` optional to avoid bloating. Require clients to request it. also document payload size limit ~1kb per result.
olivia: UX question: how to surface sampling? we should show a tiny note: "Telemetry sampled: 10% — may undercount token reads" so product teams know.
sanjay: Ops: enforce read concurrency limit per user for telemetry lookups (e.g., 50 simultaneous keys) and apply backpressure with 429 + `Retry-After`. We should also add server-side circuit breaker for Redis hot keys.
marta: Also recommend trimmed-mean for p50/p95 computation to avoid single outliers skewing the badge. Store pre-aggregated trimmed values.
kevin: One more API detail: prefer `includeTelemetry=compact` vs `full` to allow future expansion. `compact` must be little.
olivia: Action items: marta protos compact telemetry cache + simple mock in staging, kevin to draft API change and payload budget, sanjay to propose quota/throttles and k8s circuit-breaker settings, i'll draft rollout checklist + UX copy.
marta: ack. will post prototype link and perf numbers once ready: https://staging-console/quicksearch-telemetry
kevin: I'll add an API RFC this afternoon with examples and fallback semantics.
ryan: Ping me for UX review once mocks are up. thanks all.
